title: Looking for a 2D Character Illustrator
content: We'll provide character design concepts. You'll create high-quality, commercial-use illustrations with poses and backgrounds. Quality level matching the attached characters. Requirements: - Japanese anime art style (see attached images) - Experience with 2D game character art - Faithful to the original design (hair, outfit, colors) - work needs to match the quality of the attached examples (especially the coloring). To apply: Send your portfolio. Feel free to reach out!

author: Macztuh Rockstaa
title: HIRING: 2D DIGITAL ILLUSTRATOR / STORYBOOK ARTIST
content: We’re a startup character brand looking for a talented digital illustrator to bring our original characters and stories to life! We’re looking for artists who can create beautiful fantasy storybook illustrations with expressive characters, detailed environments, atmospheric lighting, and a magical, cinematic feel, similar to the attached reference. The illustrations will be used for Instagram and Facebook storytelling posts, where viewers swipe through a series of images to follow a short story. What we’re looking for: Strong 2D digital illustration skills. Experience with fantasy environments and expressive characters. Ability to maintain consistent character designs across different scenes. Strong visual storytelling and composition. Good communication and reliability. IMPORTANT - NO AI ARTWORK. For transparency, the attached reference was AI-generated solely to visualize our concept and desired artistic direction. We do not want AI-generated or AI-enhanced artwork. All commissioned illustrations must be created by the artist using their own artistic skills. Budget & Long-Term Opportunity: We’re a startup working with a modest budget, so we’ll be choosing an artist whose quality, style, and rates best fit what we can currently afford. We respect artists’ time and craftsmanship, and our goal is to build a lasting working relationship with someone who can grow alongside our company. Interested? Please message me with: 1. Your portfolio or previous artwork. 2. Your rates per illustration and for a complete set of 6 illustrations. 3. Your estimated turnaround time. 4. The software you use. Thanks so much. Contact: message the poster.

content: HIRING!
